# @eona-x/ui-toolkit-css

The stylesheets of the EONA-X design system — the class names `@eona-x/ui-toolkit-react` and
`@eona-x/ui-toolkit-svelte` render resolve here. Derived from the `assets/` the Yew crate embeds,
so the three stacks look the same because they read the same rules.

```js
import '@eona-x/ui-toolkit-css'; // tokens + components + ontology
```

```html
<div class="eona-ui"> <!-- every component goes inside one of these --> </div>
```

**Every rule is scoped under `.eona-ui`.** Put that class on an ancestor of the components — the
app root, or just the region that uses them. The stylesheet then touches nothing outside it: no
global reset, no `body` offset, and `.btn` or `.wrap` cannot collide with the host's own.
Inside the scope the toolkit's element resets apply and the root carries the EONA-X typography,
so a component looks the same in a host app as on an EONA-X page.

| Entry | What |
| --- | --- |
| `@eona-x/ui-toolkit-css` | `index.css`: tokens, components and ontology, in that order |
| `@eona-x/ui-toolkit-css/tokens.css` | the charter palette and the semantic layer (`--eona-surface-page`, …), as `:root` custom properties; dark mode via `<html data-theme="dark">` |
| `@eona-x/ui-toolkit-css/components.css` | component styles, scoped |
| `@eona-x/ui-toolkit-css/ontology.css` | `OntoBadge` and `OntoAnnotation`, scoped |
| `@eona-x/ui-toolkit-css/page.css` | **opt-in**, global: the EONA-X page shell (reset on `body`, headings, links; the 156px offset under the fixed `SiteHeader`). Only for an app whose whole page is an EONA-X page |
| `@eona-x/ui-toolkit-css/logo/logo-transparent.svg` | the mark `SiteHeader` renders from `logo/logo-transparent.svg` relative to the page — serve it there |
